title: GravaStar Launches Mercury V98 Pro Chrome Edge Keyboard with UFO Hall Effect Switches
description: GravaStar has introduced the Mercury V98 Pro Chrome Edge, a 98% gaming keyboard with Hall Effect magnetic switches and an 8,000 Hz polling rate. While it does have the same cyberpunk design as the Mercury K98 Pro launched in June, the V98 Pro is wired-only and has no battery or wireless connectivity. The chassis combines an aluminium alloy top frame and positioning plate with a plastic base and aluminium trim. It also uses a five-layer dampening system. The keyboard features GravaStar UFO Silver Mist magnetic switches, with adjustable actuation and Rapid Trigger sensitivity in 0.005 mm increments. Total key travel is 3.5 mm, with an initial force of 40 gf and an actuation force of 45 gf. The switches are hot-swappable while the keyboard is compatible with Gateron Magnetic Jade Pro, Jade Max, and TTC Magneto models. Other features include a 1.65-inch (142 x 428) TFT display, volume and mute control, and four onboard profiles. The keyboard has 16 backlight effects and five modes for its three-sided and foot ambient lighting. Settings are managed through a web-based driver, with support for Windows and macOS. The Mercury V98 Pro Chrome Edge measures 460 x 170 x 62.5 mm, weighs 1.5 kg, and is listed for $269.95.
